title: Terminal Commands
description: Project commands for the Terminal Commands extension. Each command runs in its own integrated terminal.

commands.description: The project's commands, in the order they are listed in the sidebar.

name.description: Label in the sidebar and name of the terminal. Must be unique. Defaults to the command line.

command.description: Command line, run by your default shell, e.g. "pnpm run dev:web".

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace folder or absolute. Defaults to the workspace folder.

env.description: Environment variables to add to the inherited environment.

autoStart.description: Start the command when the project opens. You are asked to allow this the first time, and again whenever the auto-start commands change.
